items.title: London Calling – Ep. 2: Alfredo Giani and Amaraterra on London One Radio
items.description: Second episode with Alfredo Giani of the Amaraterra band: the origins of pizzica, the tarantolati tradition and the countdown to the Puglian Italian Fest. With Philip Baglini Olland and Rosita Pirulli from London One Radio.

items.title: Pugliesi nel Mondo UK on London One Radio: Puglian Italian Fest announcement
